scope: Sri Lanka disaster-displacement camps. Food and water only.

food_child.source: subject_user.csv + consumption_user.csv — Sri Lanka 24h dietary recall, survey median
food_child.caveat: Survey covers ages 6-14 only. Ages 0-5 and 15-17 fall in the same children_ratio bucket but were never surveyed.

food_adult.evidence: production configuration — the quantity actually issued

food_elderly.source: measured ratio to adult (1.066) from the BRIGHT Sri Lanka household survey, n=4,229 people aged 60-74, anchored to the production adult rate
food_elderly.evidence: measured ratio — Sri Lankan household survey, February 2025
food_elderly.caveat: The ratio is measured; the absolute value is that ratio applied to the production adult rate, because the survey measures raw at-home food and the camp issues cooked weight.

food_elderly_75plus.source: measured ratio to adult (0.855) from the BRIGHT Sri Lanka household survey, n=1,214 people aged 75+, anchored to the production adult rate
food_elderly_75plus.evidence: measured ratio — Sri Lankan household survey, February 2025
food_elderly_75plus.caveat: The ratio is measured; the absolute value is that ratio applied to the production adult rate, because the survey measures raw at-home food and the camp issues cooked weight.

food_elderly_blended.source: population-weighted blend of the two measured bands (77.7% aged 60-74, 22.3% aged 75+, from n=5,443 people in the survey)
food_elderly_blended.evidence: measured ratio — used only when a roster does not distinguish 60-74 from 75+

water_drinking.source: Sphere Handbook basic survival water needs: 2.5-3.0 L per person per day for drinking and food preparation. Planning value is the upper bound.
water_drinking.evidence: humanitarian standard — no Sri Lankan measurement available
water_drinking.caveat: consumption_user.csv WATER_g is 100% empty and cleaned_global_water_consumption.csv contains no Sri Lanka rows (see resource-model/rejected/), so no local water consumption data exists to calibrate against.
water_drinking.divergence_from_production: distribution.json issues 15 L/person/day, which is the Sphere BASIC DOMESTIC figure (drinking + cooking + hygiene). This model deliberately reports the narrower survival DRINKING requirement. The two are not interchangeable.

water_pregnant_topup.evidence: NOT APPLIED — distribution.json specifies +2 L, but that value was defined against the 15 L domestic basis and does not transfer to a 3 L drinking basis without a source.

population_scale.caveat: All events are disaster-driven, not conflict-driven. This is the reference class the model serves.

kcal_per_capita_day.evidence: corroboration only — national annual supply, not a camp ration
kcal_per_capita_day.comparison: Humanitarian planning minimum is 2100 kcal/person/day; Sri Lankan national supply sits above it across all years 2010-2023.

_provenance_note: Every value above carries an 'evidence' field: 'measured' (derived from a Sri Lankan dataset), 'production configuration' (read from the live ration config), 'humanitarian standard' (named external standard), or 'ASSUMPTION'. As of schema 3 no rate is an assumption: the elderly rates were replaced with measured ratios from the BRIGHT Sri Lanka household survey and split at age 75.
